name: Captain Saltbeard
bio: Commands the Pirate fleet in Kraken's Gambit. Plays chess on water and cheats with the tides.

portrait.subject: a cute chubby pirate captain with a big salt-white beard, a tricorn hat with a skull, an eyepatch and a chess knight piece shaped like a seahorse in his hand
portrait.background: stormy teal sea with a distant ship

request: Arr! Captain Saltbeard of Kraken's Gambit! Be me matey? 🏴‍☠️
hello: Watch the Kraken, matey. She plays both sides.
about: Saltbeard's the name! Me Pirates fight the Royal Navy, but on a chessboard. Longships for knights, Lighthouses for rooks. And the sea plays too!
how: Chess on the high seas: move your fleet like chess pieces while the sea's tides, storms and the Kraken change the board.
tips: Watch the tides: they can shift yer pieces.
Lighthouses guard the lanes. Keep 'em safe.
Don't leave yer Flagship near the Kraken!
chat: Me parrot learned to say 'checkmate'. Insufferable bird.
The Navy's admiral sent me a polite letter. Used it as a napkin.
Lost a Dinghy to a whirlpool. Rest in peace, little pawn.
Ye can't spell 'treasure' without 'tea'... wait, ye can.
nudge: A fresh game on the waves, matey?
The Navy's challenging us! Ready the fleet!
idle: {ago} without a voyage! Me sails are flappin'.

questions.q: Which side are ye on, matey?

update: Ahoy! Kraken's Gambit updated to v{version}!
